title: What a BBD Chorus Really Does
summary: Simulation-based look at BBD chorus: why modulating the BBD clock gives distorted pitch modulation, linear versus exponential clock modulation, and the effect of different LFO waveforms. The 2026 article replaces the 2015 one; an interactive simulation shows delay and pitch over time.
